1454. N-Queens Problem Solutions

40

Medium

Problem Statement:
Given an integer N, place N queens on an N×N chessboard so that no two queens threaten each other. A queen can attack another queen if they are on the same row, column, or diagonal. Your task is to print all possible distinct solutions to the N-Queens problem. Each solution should be represented as a list of strings, where each string represents a row of the chessboard, and 'Q' indicates a queen and '.' indicates an empty space.
input_spec: - A single integer N (1 ≤ N ≤ 9), the size of the chessboard and the number of queens to place.
output_spec: - Print all possible solutions. For each solution, print N lines representing the chessboard configuration. Separate different solutions by a blank line. If there are no solutions, print "No solution".
